name: Begum Rokeya University, Rangpur
about: Begum Rokeya University, Rangpur is a public university established in 2008 as Rangpur University and later named after the writer and social reformer Begum Rokeya. Its 75-acre campus was built on land from Carmichael College, and classes began on the main campus in 2011. It has 6 faculties and 22 departments, with around 7,000 students.
